name: MiSTer Game Boy PPU selected logic
status: Mixer, shift and fetch components adapted; timing/controller integration and full acceptance in progress
purpose: Adapt selected DMG renderer, OAM selection and timing logic; independent project interfaces and verification remain required
planned_local_changes: Specialize DMG and remove CGB, extra sprites, savestates and platform integration
Convert to logic-only SystemVerilog with separate declarations and shared register/assertion macros
Adapt CPU commit and emulated-dot phases without fabric clocks or hidden extra dots
Use project direct-entry reset values and owned memory interface
Add explicit source/observer cancellation and generation-qualified LCD blank presentation
Remove FF46/DMA engine; issue132 owns scheduling/arbitration/corruption and issue130 owns the single backing store
use_boundary: Private project only in this issue; no source/bitstream external release. Derived files retain GPL-3.0-or-later. Any later distribution of a combined work requires a compatible release review; original unrelated material is not relicensed.

derived_files.section: DMG pixel priority and palette selection
derived_files.local_changes: Extract pure combinational DMG path; logic-only named ports; explicitly treat disabled background as raw color0 for priority; remove CGB and all state/platform dependencies

derived_files.section: Background/window and DMG object shift state
derived_files.local_changes: Extract six eight-bit planes with explicit paused-safe reset and line clear; separate fetch controls from state; preserve pre-edge emptiness and load-over-shift priority; remove CGB and extra-sprite branches; use shared register/assertion macros

Extract DMG phase/plane state; preserve pre-edge phase-five response bypass and ordered updates; explicit reset and fail-closed response input; exclude CGB/platform/save-state/extra-sprite logic; macro registers and named assertions

derived_files.section: DMG line counters, LY comparison history, mode and interrupt conditions
derived_files.local_changes: Extract one-dot enable timing with explicit direct reset; retain quarter-dot phase and delayed condition/mode history; remove CGB/save-state/CPU/DMA dependencies; macro registers and named assertions. Exact startup/LY153/STAT/WX integration gates remain subject to independent source-backed validation

derived_files.section: First-ten OAM evaluation and DMG object fetch selection
derived_files.local_changes: Remove both local dpram stores, all save-state and sprites_extra branches; expose arbitrated pair address/phase/response; explicit control/array reset; retain scan capture/selection and fetch priority ordering; macro registers and named assertions. DMA/corruption remains external132 owner

derived_files.section: DMG LCD register writes and readback
derived_files.local_changes: Use generated addresses/direct-entry fill and CPU T4 commit interface; exclude FF46/CGB/save-state; expose LCD transitions and STAT-write event separately from timing/IRQ; enforce tick/quarter alignment with named assertions; use shared macros

derived_files.section: Pixel counter, fine-scroll pause and source-pixel enable
derived_files.local_changes: Extract rawX/scroll control; retain explicit terminal-pixel event; latch fineSCX at first background map-fetch boundary instead of live low bits; macro reset/enable and named range assertions; expose source-coordinate event without platform RGB

derived_files.section: DMG WY/WX qualification and window row/column state
derived_files.local_changes: Extract DMG persistent WY and delayed WX/window state; preserve repeated activation row increments and WX166 delayed match; remove CGB/platform dependencies; macro registers and explicit reset

derived_files.section: Composed DMG renderer and selected memory address priority
derived_files.local_changes: Connect separately adapted helpers; original project A/B source-event forwarding, cancellation, first-frame shade suppression and display qualification; external memory and epoch/dot interfaces; no platform/snapshot store
